data.value: Ruth Kelleher has been trying to get the same three families away together since March and has finally found somewhere that works — Cove Cottage in Beadnell, £1,800 for the October half-term week, the 24th to the 31st. Marian Prowse, who owns it and runs it out of a paper diary, rang Ruth on Friday to say a couple from Leeds have asked about that same week, and that she'll hold it until the end of Wednesday but not a day longer; she wants the £600 deposit in her bank account by then. That's £200 a household. Ruth has already booked the week off and told her kids, but she also fronted £340 for a group meal last year and was still chasing the last of it in the spring, so she is not keen on being the one who covers people again. Dev Sandhu is completely up for it and has said so twice in the thread, but a new clutch took £620 off him a fortnight ago and he isn't paid until the 28th, and he has a credit card he promised his wife he'd stop using. Nina Achebe hasn't replied at all — not out of rudeness, but because her mum came out of hospital after a fall three weeks ago and Nina genuinely doesn't know what October looks like yet, and saying that out loud would make it a thing she has to deal with. Will the full £600 have reached Marian's account by the end of Wednesday the 16th — however it gets there, split three ways or covered by one of them or any other route?
